title: Cheesy Pillow cases..Not the microfiber that I know of !
text:
Cheesy Pillow cases..Not the microfiber that I know of !. I just got these pillow cases..
They felt cheesy, they look cheesy, and they feel like a cheap type of Nylon.
I washed them, thinking they might feel better..NO, there worse.
I'm surprised they did not fall apart in the washer and dryer.

These look like they where sewn by a 7 yr old..

I do have Microfiber sheets, so I do what I am talking about.
These to not compare to what I already have, and there not even as soft as my old regular cotton pillow cases,
and sheets..

These are such a waste of money, although not allot..
I think I'll just put them in my little Dog's bed, cause she will not know the difference!! (maybe)

I can't understand the good reviews on these, Or could I have gotten something that was throw away, then rewrapped!
